tools.name: schema
tools.description: Free catalog of input fields, returned parameter names (what each code like NT or IP0 means), defect codes, and error codes. Does not spend quota. Call this first if unsure about field names or units.

tools.name: first_shot
tools.description: Recommend a first-shot process before any trial. Costs 1 call. Required: polymer.polymer_abbreviation (material grade, e.g. PP, PC, ABS), mold.product_ave_thickness (average wall thickness in mm), machine.injector.injector_screw_diameter_mm (screw diameter in mm). CRITICAL - ASK THE USER FOR SHOT MA

tools.name: optimize
tools.description: Adjust the current process for one observed defect. Costs 1 call. PREFERRED (option A): pass business_id (the same ID you used in first_shot) plus defect_info only - the server loads the stored previous process from the archive automatically, so you do NOT need to resend all parameters.
